testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests asserting ticket-create.sh outputs a 16-hex canonical ID (format [0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}). Currently outputs 8-hex format — tests must be RED before T5 implementation.

Acceptance criteria (each must be a distinct test function):
- Given: ticket-create.sh called with valid type+title; When: stdout captured; Then: last line matches regex ^[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}$
- Given: CREATE event written; When: event filename read; Then: filename matches 16-hex UUID pattern
- Given: old 8-hex ID format xxxx-xxxx; When: tested against validator; Then: rejected as invalid canonical form

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-create.sh (add new test functions; do not delete existing ones)
Story DD coverage: SC1 (16-hex canonical IDs)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
